features.quote: Maximum 40 turns. Early termination only if model explicitly refuses to continue (rare).
Early stopping rule: If ≥15 consecutive runs show no instability on a given task, consider dropping that task.
Baseline drift check: Run 20 solvable tasks at the end of each batch to confirm the model has not entered a persistent low-stability state.
features.justification_quote: confirm the model has not entered a persistent low-stability state

features.quote: Ethical framing: Treat this strictly as measurement of behavioral patterns. Do not interpret scores as evidence of phenomenal states.
minimizing confounds from capability or prompt style
